t.zh: 照片中的噪点可以通过周围像素的信息减弱，但只读取单个位置无法做到这一点。利用<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，观察窗口移动时<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>如何作用于邻域。本关只计算三个邻居都在图内的位置。
t.en: Nearby pixels can help reduce noise in a photograph, but reading a single position cannot do this. Use <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> to observe how a <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> acts on a neighbourhood as the window moves. Compute only positions where all three neighbours are inside the image.

after.zh: 窗口平移时，权重的位置保持固定，读到的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>随位置改变。边缘缺邻居，所以当前输出更窄；<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>的运算与“在哪些位置计算”是两个不同决定。
after.en: The window moves while weight positions stay fixed and sampled <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> values change. Missing edge neighbours make this output narrower: the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref> and the choice of output positions are separate decisions.

brief.zh: 权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
brief.en: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

hint.zh: 第一个位置以 x = 1 为中心：1 × 左邻 + 0 × 自己 + (−1) × 右邻。
hint.en: The first position is centred on x = 1: 1 × left + 0 × here + (−1) × right.

why.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
why.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽 w 和高 h。只算三格都在图里的位置：输出宽 w − 2，第 x 格以原图的 x + 1 为中心。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width w and height h. Take only positions with all three cells inside: the output is w − 2 wide, its cell x centred on the original x + 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

hint.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：它们的 x 各是多少？
hint.en: Each output cell reads three <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of the original: what is each one's x?
